summary: Ruanyun Edai Technology Inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 5, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the launch of its YeeZo University AI Content Training Program, a strategic initiative to integrate AIGC training into university curricula. The filing contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or management change. It is purely a routine operational announcement for a foreign private issuer. Therefore, the filing does not meet any special-situations category and is classified as None.
